name: one table, one filter - the recorded query typed in lower case with a double-quoted literal
expected: SELECT name FROM suppliers WHERE country = 'Spain';

input_data.question: List the names of all suppliers based in Spain.

probes.good: SELECT name FROM suppliers WHERE country = 'Spain';
probes.equivalent_good:
select name
  from suppliers
  where country = "Spain"
probes.partial: SELECT name FROM suppliers WHERE country = 'Portugal';

name: one join - the same statement spread over several lines without the semicolon
expected: SELECT products.name FROM products JOIN suppliers ON products.supplier_id = suppliers.supplier_id WHERE suppliers.name = 'Castellano Olive Estates';

input_data.question: Which products are supplied by Castellano Olive Estates?

probes.good: SELECT products.name FROM products JOIN suppliers ON products.supplier_id = suppliers.supplier_id WHERE suppliers.name = 'Castellano Olive Estates';
probes.equivalent_good:
SELECT products.name
FROM products
JOIN suppliers ON products.supplier_id = suppliers.supplier_id
WHERE suppliers.name = 'Castellano Olive Estates'
probes.partial: SELECT products.name FROM products JOIN suppliers ON products.supplier_id = suppliers.supplier_id WHERE suppliers.name = 'Harbourside Pulses';

name: join with group, order and limit - keywords in lower case, padding inside the parentheses
expected: SELECT suppliers.name, COUNT(*) AS shipment_count FROM shipments JOIN suppliers ON shipments.supplier_id = suppliers.supplier_id GROUP BY suppliers.supplier_id ORDER BY shipment_count DESC LIMIT 1;

input_data.question: Which supplier has sent us the most shipments?

probes.good: SELECT suppliers.name, COUNT(*) AS shipment_count FROM shipments JOIN suppliers ON shipments.supplier_id = suppliers.supplier_id GROUP BY suppliers.supplier_id ORDER BY shipment_count DESC LIMIT 1;
probes.equivalent_good:
select suppliers.name, count( * ) as shipment_count
from shipments join suppliers on shipments.supplier_id = suppliers.supplier_id
group by suppliers.supplier_id
order by shipment_count desc
limit 1;
probes.partial: SELECT suppliers.name, COUNT(*) AS shipment_count FROM shipments JOIN suppliers ON shipments.supplier_id = suppliers.supplier_id WHERE shipments.warehouse = 'Riverside' GROUP BY suppliers.supplier_id ORDER BY shipment_count DESC LIMIT 1;
probes.bad: SELECT name, unit_price FROM products WHERE unit_price > 20;
